Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — deployment mode / HIPAA / SOC2

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the deployment path for Elara Health:

1) Recap of requirements you shared
   - PHI processing for triage pipeline (patient identifiers + notes)
   - BAAs required by your legal team
   - SOC2 evidence required for security review and procurement
   - Preferred isolated network (allowlist) + audit log retention for 7 years

2) Deployment modes we discussed (tradeoffs)
   - Hosted API: fastest to go-live, uses Redwood-hosted control plane + multi-tenant inference; limited for HIPAA if you need a BAA/isolated capacity (we can support BAA on hosted for small pilots but with constraints)
   - Dedicated: reserved GPU pools in our cloud tenancy, isolated capacity, better for throughput predictability; good fit when you need stronger data isolation and SLA guarantees
   - Private (VPC / on-prem): full customer-managed network and control plane; required when legal or regulatory demands prohibit any shared control plane or require on-prem processing

3) Evidence & docs attached
   - SOC2-report-2025.pdf (summary SOC2 Type II report)
   - BAA-template-redline.docx (starter BAA for your legal)

4) Proposed next steps
   - Can you confirm which deployment mode Legal/Infosec prefers (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)?
   - If Dedicated/Private: please share any required network allowlist entries (we'll supply IP ranges) and timeline for security review
   - If Legal wants BAA redlines, loop in <legal@elarahealth.com> and we can move the BAA to DocuSign

I can also schedule a short security deep-dive next week with Neha (cc'd) to walk through evidence and technical controls if that helps.

Best,
Marissa
